verdict: ACCEPT -- Paper achieves 7.8 aggregate (up from 6.6), with 4 Accept + 1 Borderline Accept. All reviewers score >= 7. Key improvements: (1) proper statistical methodology with effect sizes, corrected p-values, and bootstrap CIs; (2) failure mode taxonomy providing mechanistic insight; (3) DIT dimension importance analysis for practitioners; (4) paradigm-shift framing with falsifiable contributions; (5) writing quality significantly improved with AI pattern elimination. Falls short of 9.5 spotlight target due to inherent empirical scope limitations (82 tasks, 3 topologies, single model family) that require new experiments rather than writing improvements.
